name: @singularity/plugin-framework-browser-server
description: A third host of the unified live API, running in a page (or a worker): createBrowserServer({ serve, routes, unserved }) holds a real resource runtime and the shared HTTP router, serves liveValue / liveCollection declarations through the same serveValueOn / serveCollectionOn every host runs, answers every other known resource key with a loader failure, and connects in-memory sockets; browserServerTransport(server) is the Transport a <TransportProvider> points a subtree at, so the unchanged app reads it through useLive / endpoints.
